description: Use when someone asks how high to mount or hang a TV, whether it can go above a fireplace, or how far to sit from a screen of a given size. Returns the centre height, the edges, the viewing angles and the THX and SMPTE seat distances.

above_fireplace.description: yes if the screen goes above a fireplace or mantel.

eye_height_cm.description: Seated eye height from the floor (most sofas: 100–110 cm) (cm).

mantel_height_cm.description: The mantel’s height from the floor (only with above_fireplace yes) (cm).

screen_size_in.description: The screen’s diagonal size in inches, as sold (in).

seat_distance_cm.description: The distance from the seat to the screen (cm).

name: tv_height_distance

centre_height_cm.description: The screen’s centre from the floor

look_down_deg.description: From the eyes to the bottom edge (negative: up)

look_up_deg.description: From the eyes to the top edge

seat_for_limit_cm.description: The seat distance that keeps the top edge within the limit

seat_range_cm.description: [THX 40°, SMPTE 30°] seat distances for this screen

size_for_seat.description: The screen sizes that fill SMPTE’s and THX’s angles from this seat: smpte_in, thx_in

study_seat_cm.description: The distance people chose in one lab study (24–65 in screens only)

thx_farthest_cm.description: The far end of THX’s range

view_angle_deg.description: How much of the view the screen fills from the seat
